snippet_primary: "Seller requested more time to complete two custom handmade items. SEVEN MONTHS later, I am still without my refund or items after a refund was requested back in December 2024. Shop is now closed and Etsy is stating that my refund request wasn't valid, even though I was following their prompts. Unfortunately I will no longer be purchasing on Etsy due to the companies inability to protect their customers against scammers."
